question: Which syllables and name are to be applied at the end of the guhyaka word?
premises: The syllables jhaṃ and ñaṃ are specified.
The placement is at the end of the word guhyaka.
Ajitā is included following the previous supreme pattern.
inference: One should apply jhaṃ and ñaṃ with Ajitā at the end of the guhyaka word as before.
plain_english: Use jhaṃ and ñaṃ at the end of the word guhyaka with Ajitā, as before in the supreme manner.
